name: ALUETTE
description: Aluette is a four-player French trick-taking game using a 48-card Spanish-suited pack with a fixed rank order where suits are irrelevant for trick strength.

content.text: Aluette is a four-player French trick-taking game using a 48-card Spanish-suited pack with a fixed rank order where suits are irrelevant for trick strength.
Aluette is associated with Vendee and the Brittany coast, with possible roots in late medieval Luettes or a later Spanish-merchant influence via Nantes.
Four in two fixed partnerships, partners opposite. Deal and play clockwise.
48-card Spanish pack (A, K, Cavalier, Jack, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 in each suit) with Aluette fixed rank order.
48-card Spanish-suited pack (Aluette designs); optional score sheet.

First dealer by deal-until-high-four (monsieur/madame vs borgne/vache); madame deals first. Nine cards each in batches of three; 12 left (optional chanter: 6 each to left of dealer and dealer, then each discards 6).

items.text: Chanter: If all agree, dealer and player to dealer's left each receive six extra cards and discard six back to nine-card hands.
Announced Mordienne: Mordienne must be announced in advance and match may be played to 10 points.
